name: icon-swap
description: One glyph becoming another in place (ADR 0028; craft rule 10). Every glyph is rendered once and kept, stacked in one cell; show names the visible one. The old glyph fades out on --ui-duration-fast while dipping to 0.8 and blurring to 2px, the new one fades in on --ui-duration-base from there, growing back and sharpening; scale and blur ride --ui-motion-travel, so Reduced is a plain cross-fade, and no glyph has a filter at rest. State is a data attribute and motion a CSS transition: nothing mounts, a second change mid-swap turns around, and the first render is still. aria-hidden — the host's accessible name carries the state.
